title: Mercator makes Greenland look Africa-sized
body: Mercator's 1569 projection preserves angles, priceless for navigation, by stretching land near the poles. Greenland (about 2.2 million km2) inflates to look Africa-sized (about 30 million). Generations of schoolchildren absorbed a wrong hierarchy of continents from a sailor's tool doing exactly its designed job.
